blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: The combined name is a board sub-area, not one City neighbourhood.
It joins Sunshine Hills and Sunshine Woods, neighbourhoods 12 and 13 of 14 in the former North Delta Area Plan.
The working grid is 72 Avenue north, 64 Avenue south, Watershed Park and Lyon Road west, and Scott Road (120 Street) east; the City publishes no street-by-street boundary for the combined name.
Panorama Ridge in Surrey lies south across 64 Avenue, and Scottsdale lies north-east across Scott Road.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Houses here are mainly freehold single detached homes under a Small Scale Residential designation in Delta's 2024 Official Community Plan (OCP).
Subdivision minimums vary widely by zone, from RS7 at 335 m² to RS1 at 4,000 m², so lot size is a zone question, not an area average.
Duplex minimums in the bylaw ladder include RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m².

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Delta allows up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots under its small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) updates.
Delta's SSMUH rules allow combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites.

Delta is proposing to consolidate 12 small-scale residential zones into one and permit houseplexes of three or four units with separate exterior entrances; this was a proposal at engagement stage, not an adopted rule.
Zoning is parcel-by-parcel under Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Sunshine Hills Park is at 11195 Bond Blvd and lists pickleball, tennis courts, playgrounds, picnic tables and trails.
Sunshine Hills Elementary, 11285 Bond Blvd, is a Kindergarten to Grade 7 school in SD37.
Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Ave, at the north-west edge of the area.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Delta adopted a new housing-focused OCP on July 8, 2024, with a provincial housing target of 3,607 net new units in five years.
Delta's Housing Our Future page maps larger multi-unit projects that are in application review, under construction or recently completed, citywide.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility total is $1,658 for a single-family home, up from $1,607 in 2025.
Flat-rate utility bills are issued at the end of February and cover garbage and recycling, with water and sewer either on that bill or on separate quarterly metered bills.
Delta's 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after that date and a further 5% after September 2, 2026.
The City of Delta is listed as a taxable area for the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT), so owners must complete the annual declaration.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: getting around

items.t: Route 340 runs through the area on Kittson Parkway, between Scottsdale Exchange and 22nd Street Station via 64 Avenue, Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge.
Route 319 runs along 72 Avenue on the north edge, between Scott Road Station and Newton Exchange.
Route 640 runs Ladner Exchange to Scott Road Station via River Road, Highway 17 and the Highway 91 Connector.
Highway 91 access for this area is via 64 Avenue, on the TransLink route description for route 340.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check Cougar Creek setbacks before valuing a lot's buildable area. Cougar Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse through Surrey and Delta, the City has done bank-stabilization work in Cougar Canyon, and streamside setback detail is lot-specific.

Check Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) status parcel by parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission map; the OCP map shows no Agricultural designation for this part of North Delta, which is not a parcel-level ruling.
Confirm the parcel zone under Bylaw No. 7600 before assuming suite, coach-house or subdivision rights, because zone minimums range from 335 m² to 4,000 m².

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

69 houses sold in Sunshine Hills Woods with a median price of $1,260,000 (the middle half sold between $1,172,500 and $1,399,000), taking a median of 17 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $521 per square foot, a median year built of 1979 and a median lot of 6,760 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 43 houses listed in Sunshine Hills Woods. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sunshine Hills Woods a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Sunshine Hills Woods had a sales ratio of 28%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sunshine Hills Woods from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 44 houses sold in Sunshine Hills Woods over those 5 months, out of 154 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
Catchment depends on the exact address, so check it before you buy. SD37 has no middle-school tier. Other streets in the area can fall in different catchments, so run each address in the locator.

faq.q: What is Watershed Park, next to these houses?
faq.a: Watershed Park is Delta's largest park and sits on the west side of this area. The City gives its address as 11600 Kittson Pkwy and describes eleven kilometres of gravel trails.

faq.q: Can I add a coach house or garden suite?
faq.a: Yes, in the combinations Delta's SSMUH rules allow, if your parcel's zoning permits it. Delta states its regulations allow single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites in combination. Confirm the parcel's zone sheet under Bylaw No. 7600 first, because minimum lot sizes differ sharply between zones.

faq.q: Where does the drinking water come from?
faq.a: Most Delta water comes from Metro Vancouver, and about 1% comes from Delta wells near Watershed Park. The City's 2024 water report says well water is pumped from deep wells in Sunshine Hills into the 64 Avenue Reservoir and supplied by gravity to the lowland area south of 64 Avenue.

faq.q: What did houses in Sunshine Hills Woods sell for?
faq.a: 69 houses sold in Sunshine Hills Woods between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,260,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: The median was 17 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.4% of the last list price (10% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
